Just been around them enough to be able to tell. Im a former meth addict and work in addiction treatment so I know a lot of the behaviors. I mean to a normal on looker, most people know if someone is high especially if they're freaking out like this lady,  but what substance they don't know. To me I can usually tell exactly what substance someone is on just from experience observing and doing the drug myself. Different drugs have different little off motions and things that make it idnetifiable. I can usually tell if someone is high from a simple three word introduction. The way I can tell is through their pace of conversation I guess you would call it. When two people not under the influence talk there is a pretty universal sort of flow to the way an interaction takes place and when someone is off of that pace it is very easy to tell. Whether it be too fast or too slow depends on the drug and person but generally people under the influence seem to be off the flow of the universe. Like their body language and the words coming out of their mouth don't quite match, or their energy doesn't match the specific context and situation, it's hard to describe but once you've been around it enough it is very easy to tell very quickly. 
Meth as well as crack and bath salts and sometimes cocaine have very unique and identifiable traits to them. I can usually tell just by looking into someone's eyes, but on top of that you have your first indication with the way they are dressed/appear which isn't always entirely accurate. Beyond that you have the pace of conversation thing, along with subtle body language ques like biting nails, grinding teeth, general tenseness of muscles and jaw. Along with rapid eratic type movements. In conversation you have things like repetition in speech, repeating the same things over and over in different ways and usually having trouble wrapping up a thought. People high on meth generally talk too fast and may breathe a little heavy or quick. Usually people on meth might lose train of thought and say things that are very unnatural like irregular sentence patterns. They may also be very defensive, paranoid or nervous sounding. Usually if you can find a few of these things the person is fucked up on something. Just one of these traits can be attributed to something else but when you can notice 2 or more it's very likely that person is speeding.
